notes.title: Update 12/9
notes.content:
Greetings
We are pleased to tell you the Holo Impact is supported Oculas Rift Touch right now.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26829016/139d235cc27ce68576f0413b2f8fb4121d4e4c64.jpg[/img]

For the best play experience, we have recommended you to set the sensor position at both sides of  the diagonal.  And the game is native designed for "Touch controller" ONLY. Xbox one controller is not supported in Holo Impact.

Thanks for your support in Holo Impact.

notes.title: Game Update 12/1
notes.content:
Greetings 

We have released a small game update today, including
[list]
[*]HUD will show the message (Out of Range/ No Target) when you have special weapon and press the button but nothing happened.
[*]Adjust the position of  the virtual START button and the virtual KEYBOARD (at game over) by PRESS the grip button on the controller and MOVE your vive glass position.
[/list]
